limits: One scalar teacher-forced run per implementation; full head evaluated at each position; includes model load and F32 dump. Not the grouped native generate benchmark.
Expert weight capacity aligned, but overall memory caps, mmap/loading, cache allocation and eviction differ. GLM reference peak 17693888440 bytes exceeds the native 16 GiB budget.
OS file cache not purged and ordering not balanced across frameworks. Qwen native run sampled 12447342592 disk-read bytes versus reference 45293568; process counters include load and other files.
No fair framework ranking, cold SSD throughput, broad quality or stable speed claim.

First cold shader compilation was not isolated.
MTP and random sampling not implemented; GLM whole-model long-context quality remains unverified.
